label.zh: 骸骨与龙蛋（各自独立，随机在1天至50年内触发）
label.en: Bones and egg (independent, each 1 day to 50 years later)

note.zh: 在宝藏行星上建成采矿站，会为两者各自安排数年后的事件。每颗行星各只发生一次；若星系易手，则重新安排。
note.en: Building a mining station on the hoard planet schedules both events for some years later. Each happens once per planet; if the system changes hands, they are rescheduled.

note.zh: 一支以太幼龙舰队“Scile”出现，且不占用舰队容量。
note.en: An Ether hatchling fleet named Scile appears; it takes no fleet capacity.

label.en: The egg is no longer viable

note.zh: 龙蛋已失去活力，之后再无结果。
note.en: The egg is lost; nothing more comes of it.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a「研究」授予龙甲（grant_dragon_armor_effect），选项 b「磨碎」给予每月矿物与社会研究加成；均不通向其他事件。
notes.en: Review note: option a grants dragon armour (grant_dragon_armor_effect), option b gives monthly minerals and society research; neither leads to another event (leviathans_events_1.txt:8824-8843).

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项 a 在首都启用孵化项目；选项 b 立刻获得300影响力。项目花费50000社会研究点，限时1800天（超时失败 → 665）。
notes.en: Review note: option a enables the incubation project at the capital; option b gives 300 influence at once (leviathans_events_1.txt:8906-8922). The project costs 50000 and has a 1800-day limit; timing out gives 665 (00_projects_leviathans.txt:430-448).

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗恒星所在的星系。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star's system appears here.
